invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2100（基于ATR 18.88和支撑位），或融资费率Z-score转正（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2042.03）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2100 (based on ATR 18.88 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2042.03).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.095（新止损位，基于ATR 0.0008和支撑），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（拥挤缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 0.10）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.095 (new stop-loss, based on ATR 0.0008 and support), or funding Z-score drops <50% (crowding eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 0.10).
